name: Apple MacBook Pro 16-inch (2023) M2 Max tech specs
notes: Apple tech-specs page for the 16-inch MacBook Pro (Jan 2023, M2 Max). States M2 Max with 12-core CPU / up to 38-core GPU, up to 96 GB unified memory, 400 GB/s memory bandwidth. M2 Max 38-core GPU config = 400 GB/s; 30-core = 400 GB/s also (M2 Max unified bandwidth is 400 GB/s across GPU bins unlike M3 Max where the 14-core CPU config drops to 300). Cited for the M2 Max accelerator record.
